newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's net foreign investments in Q1 fall.
newsitem.headline: Manila's net foreign investments in Q1 fall.

text.p: Net foreign investments in the Philippines fell 63.3 percent in the first quarter of the year to $238 million, down from $649 million a year ago, data released by the Central Bank on Tuesday showed.
Total investments from non-residents went up to $969 million from $907 million, but the outflow of funds surged to $731 million compared with $258 million.
Most of the outflows were portfolio investments or placements in foreign currency securities.
Direct investments into the country inched up to $571 million from $525 million, while portfolio investments, rose to $398 million from $382.
